items.originalTitle: George Russell breaks silence on Mexican GP media absence after Mercedes fine
items.summaryEn: Mercedes driver George Russell skipped his media duties after the Mexican Grand Prix, leading the FIA to fine Mercedes €5,000. Russell has now explained why he was absent.
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔打破沉默，谈墨西哥大奖赛后缺席媒体采访及梅赛德斯被罚款一事
乔治·拉塞尔解释了他为何在墨西哥大奖赛后缺席媒体采访
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
梅赛德斯一级方程式车手乔治·拉塞尔公开谈及上周末墨西哥大奖赛后缺席媒体职责一事。
这位英国人在周日比赛结束后不久便离开了墨西哥城赛道，此前他已向队友基米·安东内利祝贺其夺得首个世界冠军。国际汽联因拉塞尔缺席对梅赛德斯处以5000欧元罚款，但车队领队托托·沃尔夫已批准拉塞尔离场。
拉塞尔以明显夺冠热门的身份进入2026赛季。但在全年遭遇无数障碍、且大多源于他无法控制的原因之后，他眼睁睁看着队友在积分榜上扩大领先优势，并最终夺得总冠军。
在巴西大奖赛周末前夕于英特拉格斯接受F1.com采访时，拉塞尔解释了自己缺席媒体环节的原因。
“尽管我很喜欢在赛后和媒体聊天，但这一次我真的不太想。所以我就想，‘我要离开这里，去吃顿好的晚餐，想点别的事情，而不是我们这糟糕的赛季。’”
拉塞尔承认跳过媒体环节并不理想，但他也不觉得这是什么大事。
“在赛车中，你总是要重新振作起来，对我来说，重新振作的最好方式就是离开那里，”拉塞尔补充道。
“真的就这么简单。我只是非常难过，因为错过了取得好成绩的机会，因为对我来说冠军争夺已经结束了，但我就是无法相信事情又一次变成了这样。
"那一刻，是的，我只想赶紧离开那里。
"我认为自己99%的时间里都是真正的职业人士，尽量不耍脾气，但有时错过做媒体采访——好吧，这并不理想，但也不是世界末日。那样的时刻，你并不真的想去应对它。"
拉塞尔仍在争夺车手锦标赛第二名，而梅赛德斯尚未锁定车队总冠军。
detailEn: George Russell breaks silence on Mexican GP media absence after Mercedes fine
George Russell has explained why he skipped his media duties after the Mexican Grand Prix
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Mercedes Formula 1 driver George Russell has opened up about skipping his media duties after the Mexican Grand Prix last weekend.

The Briton left the Mexico City circuit shortly after the race on Sunday, having congratulated his team-mate Kimi Antonelli on clinching his maiden world championship. Mercedes was fined €5000 by the FIA for his absence, but team principal Toto Wolff had given Russell the go-ahead to leave.

Russell entered the 2026 season as a clear favourite for the title. But after facing countless hurdles throughout the year, largely due to reasons outside of his control, he watched as his team-mate extended his lead in the standings and ultimately claimed the title.
While speaking to F1.com at Interlagos ahead of the Brazilian Grand Prix weekend, Russell explained his absence from the media sessions.

"As much as I love talking to [the media] after the race, I didn’t really fancy it on this occasion. So I was like, 'I’m going to just get out of here and go for a nice dinner and think about something other than the rubbish season we’ve had.'"
Russell admitted that skipping the media sessions was not ideal but did not think it was a big deal either.
"In racing you always pick yourself back up, and for me, the best way to pick myself back up was getting out of there," Russell added.

"It was as simple as that, really. I was just very upset with missing out on the chance of a good result because the championship for me was already over but I just couldn't believe how things had panned out again.
"In that moment, yeah, I just wanted to get out of there.

"I think I'm 99% of the time a true professional and I try not to spit my dummy out, but sometimes missing out on doing the press – OK, it's not ideal but not the end of the world. Moments like that you don't really want to deal with it."
Russell is still in the fight for second in the drivers' championship, and Mercedes is yet to clinch the constructors' title.
keyPointsZh: 拉塞尔在赛后不久便离开墨西哥城赛道，此前他曾向队友安东内利祝贺其夺得首个世界冠军。
梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫此前已就此事作出表态。
keyPointsEn: Russell left the Mexico City circuit shortly after the race, having congratulated his team-mate Antonelli on clinching his maiden world championship.
Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff had already commented on the matter.
